Elaine (docs): Opening a small PR to add an 'offline installer checklist' and distro-specific package list for airgapped installs. Can infra/security confirm the runtime libs and HSM/KMS packages we should call out?

Ben (eng): For Ubuntu: ca-certificates, tzdata, systemd, curl, tar, gzip, openssl. RHEL: ca-certificates, tzdata, nss, yum-utils.

Mike (infra): Add PKCS#11/HSM stacks: pcsc-lite (pcscd), opensc, libpcsclite, pkcs11-helper, and vendor modules like libengine-pkcs11-openssl where applicable. Also list libseccomp and iproute2 as needed.

Ben (eng): For container installs mention crictl/ctr and container runtime helper tools if they're not present in the offline bundle.

Mike (infra): Suggest including short mirror & checksum snippets in docs:
```bash
# rsync mirror example for RPM
rsync -avz rsync://mirror.centos.org/centos/7/ /var/mirror/centos/7/
# create checksum for offline bundle
sha256sum redwood-offline-installer-1.2.3.tar.gz > redwood-offline-installer-1.2.3.sha256
```

Elaine (docs): Nice. I'll add a one-line verification checklist (CA bundle check, cert chain verify, pkcs11 module load test).

Mike (infra): Add these checks:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect private-repo.local:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -subject
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/opensc-pkcs11.so -L
```

Robin (security): Please include a FIPS note: customers running FIPS may need distro-specific FIPS variants and vendor-certified driver packages. Mark HSM drivers as vendor-specific and link to vendor docs.

Elaine (docs): I'll add a distro->required/optional table, the snippets above, FIPS caveat, and a small section on vendor driver install hints. Pushing PR update now.

deploy-bot: PR #3246 updated (files changed: docs/airgap/offline-install-checklist.md).

Elaine (docs): Thanks all. If you think of Windows Server edge cases or SELinux module notes, drop them here or comment on the PR. :thumbsup:
